description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing SavingsAccountTransaction entities, including methods for querying transactions by various criteria with locking for concurrency control.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for SavingsAccountTransaction entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findOneByIdAndSavingsAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves a SavingsAccountTransaction by transaction ID and savings account ID.

methods.name: findTransactionsAfterPivotDate
methods.description: Finds transactions for a savings account occurring on or after a specified date, with a pessimistic write lock.

methods.name: findTransactionRunningBalanceBeforePivotDate
methods.description: Finds transactions for a savings account on a specific date, excluding reversal and reversed transactions, with a lock.

methods.name: findBySavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a given savings account, with a lock.

methods.name: findBySavingsAccountIdAndLessThanDateOfAndReversedIsFalse
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for a savings account up to a certain date, that are not reversed, with pagination.
